title: अंश ३ · अध्याय १

items.speaker: मैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
कथिता गुरुणा सम्यग्भूसमुद्रादिसंस्थितिः ।
सूर्यादिनां च संस्थानं ज्योतिषां चातिविस्तरात् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
kathitā guruṇā samyagbhūsamudrādisaṃsthitiḥ |
sūryādināṃ ca saṃsthānaṃ jyotiṣāṃ cātivistarāt || 1 ||

items.text:
देवादीनां तथा सृष्टिर्ऋषीणां चापि वर्णिता ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य चोत्पत्तिस्तिर्यग्योनिगतस्य च ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
devādīnāṃ tathā sṛṣṭirṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi varṇitā |
cāturvarṇyasya cotpattistiryagyonigatasya ca || 2 ||

items.text:
ध्रुवप्रह्लादचरितं विस्तराच्च त्वयोदितम् ।
मन्वन्तराण्यशेषाणि श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यनुक्रमात् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
dhruvaprahlādacaritaṃ vistarācca tvayoditam |
manvantarāṇyaśeṣāṇi śrotumicchāmyanukramāt || 3 ||

items.text:
मन्वन्तराधिपांश्चैव शक एवपुरोगमान् ।
भवता कथितानेताञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं गुरो ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
manvantarādhipāṃścaiva śaka evapurogamān |
bhavatā kathitānetāñchrotumicchāmyahaṃ guro || 4 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
अतीतानागतानीह यानि मन्वन्तराणि वै ।
तान्यहं भवतः सम्यक्लथयामि यथा क्रमम् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
atītānāgatānīha yāni manvantarāṇi vai |
tānyahaṃ bhavataḥ samyaklathayāmi yathā kramam || 5 ||

items.text:
स्वायंभुवो मनुः पूर्वं परः स्वारोचिषस्तथा ।
उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ paraḥ svārociṣastathā |
uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā || 6 ||

items.text:
षडेते मनवोतीताः सांप्रतं तु रवेः सुतः ।
वैवस्वतेयं यस्त्वेतत्मप्तमं वर्ततेन्तरम् ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
ṣaḍete manavotītāḥ sāṃprataṃ tu raveḥ sutaḥ |
vaivasvateyaṃ yastvetatmaptamaṃ vartatentaram || 7 ||

items.text:
स्वायंभुवं तु कथितं कल्पादावन्तरं मया ।
देवाः सप्तर्षयश्चैव यथावत्कथिता मया ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ tu kathitaṃ kalpādāvantaraṃ mayā |
devāḥ saptarṣayaścaiva yathāvatkathitā mayā || 8 ||

items.text:
अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि मनोः स्वारोचिषस्य तु ।
मन्वन्तराधिपान्सम्यग्देवर्षिंस्तत्सुतांस्तथा ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi manoḥ svārociṣasya tu |
manvantarādhipānsamyagdevarṣiṃstatsutāṃstathā || 9 ||

items.text:
पारावताः सतुषिता देवाः स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे ।
विपश्चित्तत्र देवेन्द्रो मैत्रेयासीन्महाबलः ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
pārāvatāḥ satuṣitā devāḥ svārociṣe'ntare |
vipaścittatra devendro maitreyāsīnmahābalaḥ || 10 ||

items.text:
ऊर्जस्तंभस्तथा प्राणो वातोथ* पृषभस्तथा । (*पाठ. दत्तोग्नी ऋषभस्तथा)
निरयश्च परीवांश्च तत्र सप्तर्षयोऽभवन् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
ūrjastaṃbhastathā prāṇo vātotha* pṛṣabhastathā | (*pāṭha. dattognī ṛṣabhastathā)
nirayaśca parīvāṃśca tatra saptarṣayo'bhavan || 11 ||

items.text:
चैत्रकिंपुरुषाद्याश्च सुताः स्वारोचिषस्य तु ।
द्वितीयमेतद्व्याख्यातमन्तरं शृणु चोत्तमम् ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
caitrakiṃpuruṣādyāśca sutāḥ svārociṣasya tu |
dvitīyametadvyākhyātamantaraṃ śṛṇu cottamam || 12 ||

items.text:
तृतीयेप्यन्तरे ब्रह्मन्नुत्तमो नाम यो मनुः ।
सुशान्तिर्नाम देवेन्द्रो मैत्रेयासीत्सुताञ्छृणु ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
tṛtīyepyantare brahmannuttamo nāma yo manuḥ |
suśāntirnāma devendro maitreyāsītsutāñchṛṇu || 13 ||

items.text:
सुधामानस्तथा सत्या जपाश्चाथ प्रतर्दनाः ।
वशवर्तिश्च पञ्चैते गणा द्वादशकाः स्मृताः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
sudhāmānastathā satyā japāścātha pratardanāḥ |
vaśavartiśca pañcaite gaṇā dvādaśakāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14 ||

items.text:
वसिष्ठतनया ह्येते सप्त सप्तर्षयोभवन् ।
अजः परशुदीप्ताद्यास्तथोत्तममनोः सुताः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
vasiṣṭhatanayā hyete sapta saptarṣayobhavan |
ajaḥ paraśudīptādyāstathottamamanoḥ sutāḥ || 15 ||

items.text:
तामसस्यान्तरे देवाः सुपारा हरयस्तथा ।
सत्याश्च सुधियश्चैव सप्तविंशतिका गणाः ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
tāmasasyāntare devāḥ supārā harayastathā |
satyāśca sudhiyaścaiva saptaviṃśatikā gaṇāḥ || 16 ||

items.text:
शिविरिन्द्रस्तथा चासीच्छतयज्ञोपलक्षमः ।
सप्तर्षयश्च ये तेषां तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
śivirindrastathā cāsīcchatayajñopalakṣamaḥ |
saptarṣayaśca ye teṣāṃ teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 17 ||

items.text:
ज्योतिर्धामा पुथुः कात्यश्चैत्रोग्निर्धनकस्तथा ।
पीवरश्चर्षयो ह्येते सप्त तत्रापि चान्तरे ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
jyotirdhāmā puthuḥ kātyaścaitrognirdhanakastathā |
pīvaraścarṣayo hyete sapta tatrāpi cāntare || 18 ||

items.text:
नरः ख्यातिः केतुरूपो जानुजङ्घादयस्तथा ।
पुत्रास्तु तामसस्यासन्नाजानः सुमहाबलाः ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
naraḥ khyātiḥ keturūpo jānujaṅghādayastathā |
putrāstu tāmasasyāsannājānaḥ sumahābalāḥ || 19 ||

items.text:
पञ्चमे वापि मैत्रेय रैवतो नाम नामतः ।
मनुर्विभुश्च तत्रेन्द्रो देवांश्चात्रान्तरे शृणु ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
pañcame vāpi maitreya raivato nāma nāmataḥ |
manurvibhuśca tatrendro devāṃścātrāntare śṛṇu || 20 ||

items.text:
अमिताभा भूतरया वैकुण्ठाः सुसमेधसः ।
एते देवगणास्तत्र चतुर्दश चतुर्दश ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
amitābhā bhūtarayā vaikuṇṭhāḥ susamedhasaḥ |
ete devagaṇāstatra caturdaśa caturdaśa || 21 ||

items.text:
हिरण्यरोमा वेदाश्रिरूर्ध्वबाहुस्तथावरः ।
वेदबाहुः सुधामा च पर्जन्यश्च महामुनिः ।
एते सप्तर्षयो विप्र तत्रासन्रैवतेन्तरे ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
hiraṇyaromā vedāśrirūrdhvabāhustathāvaraḥ |
vedabāhuḥ sudhāmā ca parjanyaśca mahāmuniḥ |
ete saptarṣayo vipra tatrāsanraivatentare || 22 ||

items.text:
बलबन्धुश्च संभाव्यः सत्यकाद्याश्च तत्सुताः ।
नरेन्द्राश्च महावीर्या बभूवुर्मुनिसत्तम ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
balabandhuśca saṃbhāvyaḥ satyakādyāśca tatsutāḥ |
narendrāśca mahāvīryā babhūvurmunisattama || 23 ||

items.text:
स्वारोचिषश्चौत्तमश्च तामसो रैवतस्तथा ।
प्रियव्रतान्वया ह्येते चत्वारो मनवः स्मृताः ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
svārociṣaścauttamaśca tāmaso raivatastathā |
priyavratānvayā hyete catvāro manavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 24 ||

items.text:
विष्णुमाराध्य तपसा स राजर्षिः प्रियव्रतः ।
मन्वन्तराधिपानेताल्लंब्धवानात्मवंशजान् ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
viṣṇumārādhya tapasā sa rājarṣiḥ priyavrataḥ |
manvantarādhipānetāllaṃbdhavānātmavaṃśajān || 25 ||

items.text:
षष्ठे मन्वंरते चासीच्चाक्षुषाख्यस्तथा मनुः ।
मनोजवस्तथैवेन्द्रो देवानपि निबोध मे ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
ṣaṣṭhe manvaṃrate cāsīccākṣuṣākhyastathā manuḥ |
manojavastathaivendro devānapi nibodha me || 26 ||

items.text:
आप्याः प्रसूता भव्याश्च पृथुकाश्चा दिवौकसः ।
महानुभावा लेखाश्च पञ्चैते ह्यष्टका गणाः ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
āpyāḥ prasūtā bhavyāśca pṛthukāścā divaukasaḥ |
mahānubhāvā lekhāśca pañcaite hyaṣṭakā gaṇāḥ || 27 ||

items.text:
सुमेधा विरजाश्चैव हविष्मानुत्तमो मधुः ।
अतिनामा सहिष्णुश्च सप्तासन्निति चर्षयः ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
sumedhā virajāścaiva haviṣmānuttamo madhuḥ |
atināmā sahiṣṇuśca saptāsanniti carṣayaḥ || 28 ||

items.text:
ऊरुः पूरुः शतद्युम्नप्रमुखाः सुमहाबलाः ।
चाक्षुषस्य मनोः पुत्राः पृथिवीपतयोऽभवन् ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
ūruḥ pūruḥ śatadyumnapramukhāḥ sumahābalāḥ |
cākṣuṣasya manoḥ putrāḥ pṛthivīpatayo'bhavan || 29 ||

items.text:
विवस्वतः सुतो विप्र श्राद्धदेवो महाद्युतिः ।
मनुः संवर्तते धीमान् सांप्रतं सप्तमेन्तरे ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
vivasvataḥ suto vipra śrāddhadevo mahādyutiḥ |
manuḥ saṃvartate dhīmān sāṃprataṃ saptamentare || 30 ||

items.text:
आदित्यवसुरुद्राद्या देवाश्चात्र महामुने ।
पुरन्दरस्तथैवात्र मैत्रेय त्रिदशेश्वरः ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
ādityavasurudrādyā devāścātra mahāmune |
purandarastathaivātra maitreya tridaśeśvaraḥ || 31 ||

items.text:
वशिष्ठः काश्यपोथात्रिर्जमदग्निः सगौतमः ।
विश्वामित्रभरद्वाजौ सप्त सप्तर्षयोऽभवन् ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
vaśiṣṭhaḥ kāśyapothātrirjamadagniḥ sagautamaḥ |
viśvāmitrabharadvājau sapta saptarṣayo'bhavan || 32 ||

items.text:
इक्ष्वाकुश्च नृगश्चैव धृष्टः शर्यातिरेव च ।
नरिष्यन्तश्च विख्यातो नाभागोरिष्ट एव च ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
ikṣvākuśca nṛgaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireva ca |
nariṣyantaśca vikhyāto nābhāgoriṣṭa eva ca || 33 ||

items.text:
करूषश्च पृषध्रश्च सुमहांल्लोकविश्रुतः ।
मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यैते नव पुत्राः सुधार्मिकाः ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
karūṣaśca pṛṣadhraśca sumahāṃllokaviśrutaḥ |
manorvaivasvatasyaite nava putrāḥ sudhārmikāḥ || 34 ||

items.text:
विष्णुशक्तिरनौपम्या सत्त्वोद्रिक्ता स्थितौ स्थिता ।
मन्वन्तरेष्वशेषेषु देवत्वेनाधितिष्ठति ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
viṣṇuśaktiranaupamyā sattvodriktā sthitau sthitā |
manvantareṣvaśeṣeṣu devatvenādhitiṣṭhati || 35 ||

items.text:
अंशेन तस्या जज्ञेऽसौ यज्ञःस्वायंभुवेन्तरे ।
आकूत्यां मानसो देव उत्पन्नः प्रथमेन्तरे ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
aṃśena tasyā jajñe'sau yajñaḥsvāyaṃbhuventare |
ākūtyāṃ mānaso deva utpannaḥ prathamentare || 36 ||

items.text:
ततः पुनः स वै देवः प्राप्ते स्वारोचिषेन्तरे ।
तुषितायां समुत्पन्नो ह्याजिषस्तुषितैः सह ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ punaḥ sa vai devaḥ prāpte svārociṣentare |
tuṣitāyāṃ samutpanno hyājiṣastuṣitaiḥ saha || 37 ||

items.text:
औत्तमप्यन्तरे देवस्तुषितस्तु पुनः स वै ।
सत्यायामभवत्सत्यः सत्यैः सह सुरोत्तमैः ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
auttamapyantare devastuṣitastu punaḥ sa vai |
satyāyāmabhavatsatyaḥ satyaiḥ saha surottamaiḥ || 38 ||

items.text:
तामसस्यान्तरे चैव संप्राप्तो पुनरेव हि ।
हर्यायां हरिभिः सार्ध हरिरेव बभूव ह ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
tāmasasyāntare caiva saṃprāpto punareva hi |
haryāyāṃ haribhiḥ sārdha harireva babhūva ha || 39 ||

items.text:
रैवतेप्यन्तरे देवःसंभूत्यां मानसो हरिः ।
संभूतो रैवतैः सार्ध देवैर्देववरो हरिः ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
raivatepyantare devaḥsaṃbhūtyāṃ mānaso hariḥ |
saṃbhūto raivataiḥ sārdha devairdevavaro hariḥ || 40 ||

items.text:
चाक्षुषे चान्तरे देवो वैकुण्ठः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
विकुण्ठायामसौ जज्ञे वैकुण्ठैर्दैवतैः सह ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
cākṣuṣe cāntare devo vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
vikuṇṭhāyāmasau jajñe vaikuṇṭhairdaivataiḥ saha || 41 ||

items.text:
मन्वन्तरेत्र संप्राप्ते तथा वैवस्वते द्विज ।
वामनः काश्यपाद्विष्णुरदित्यां संबभूव ह ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
manvantaretra saṃprāpte tathā vaivasvate dvija |
vāmanaḥ kāśyapādviṣṇuradityāṃ saṃbabhūva ha || 42 ||

items.text:
त्रिभिः क्रमैरिमांल्लोकाञ्जित्वा येन महात्मना ।
पुरन्दराय त्रैलोक्यं दत्तं निहतकण्टकम् ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
tribhiḥ kramairimāṃllokāñjitvā yena mahātmanā |
purandarāya trailokyaṃ dattaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam || 43 ||

items.text:
इत्येतास्तनवस्तस्य सप्तमन्वन्तरेषु वै ।
सप्तस्वेवाभवन्विप्र याभिः संवर्धिताः प्रजाः ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr:
ityetāstanavastasya saptamanvantareṣu vai |
saptasvevābhavanvipra yābhiḥ saṃvardhitāḥ prajāḥ || 44 ||

items.text:
यस्माद्विष्टमिदं विश्वं यस्य शक्त्या महात्मनः ।
तस्मात्स प्रोच्यते विष्णुर्विशोर्धातोः प्रवेशनात् ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
yasmādviṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ yasya śaktyā mahātmanaḥ |
tasmātsa procyate viṣṇurviśordhātoḥ praveśanāt || 45 ||

items.text:
सर्वे च देवा मनवः समस्ताः सप्तर्षयो ये मनुसूनवश्च ।
इन्द्रश्चयोऽयं त्रिदशेशभूतो विष्णोरशोषास्तु विभूतयस्ताः ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
sarve ca devā manavaḥ samastāḥ saptarṣayo ye manusūnavaśca |
indraścayo'yaṃ tridaśeśabhūto viṣṇoraśoṣāstu vibhūtayastāḥ || 46 ||

en_chapter: Maitreya said:—The situation of the earth and of seas the spurn of the sun and the other planets, the creation of the celestials and the rest and of the Rishis, the origin of the four castes and of the brute creation and the stories of Dhruva and Prahlād have been fully described by thee, my preceptor. Do thou describe to me, O Venerable Sir, all the Manwantaras and all the presiding deities with Sakra as their chief. I wish to hear this from you.
Parāçara said:—I shall serially describe to you all the Manwantaras that had passed away and all that shall take place.

The first Manu was Swayambhuva. Then came Swārochisha then Auttami, then Tāmasa, then Raivata, then Chākshusa: these six Manus have passed away. Vaivaswata, the son of the sun now presides over the seventh Manwantara, which is the present period.

The era of Swayambhuva Manu, which took place in the beginning of Kalpa together with the celestials, saints and other personages, has been related by me. I will now describe to you the period of Swārochisha Manu together with the presiding deities, saints and his sons.

There flourished two classes of celestials in the Manwantara of Swārochisha named Pārāvatas and Tushitas—and the king of the celestials was the powerful Vipascbit; the seven Rishis were Urja, Stambha, Prāna, Dattoli, Rishabha, Nischara, Arvarivat; and the sons of the Manu were Chaitra, Kimpurusha and others. I have thus described to you the second Manwantara. In the third Manwantara of Uttami, Susānti was the king of the celestials, who were severally denominated as the Sudhāmas, Satyas, Sivas, Pradersanas and Vasavertis and each of these orders consisted of twelve deities. The seven sons of Vasishtha were the seven celestial saints and Aja, Parasu, Divya and others were the sons of the Manu.

In the reign of Tāmasa the fourth Manu, the Surupas, Haris, Satyas and Sudhis were the orders of the celestials each consisting of twenty-seven. Sivi was their king who was named Satakratu by his performance of hundred sacrifices; the seven Rishis were Jyotirdhāmā, Prithu, Kāvya, Chaitra, Agni, Vanaka and Pivara. The sons of Tāmasa were the powerful kings Nara, Khyāti, Sāntahaya, Jānujangha and others.

In the fifth Manwantara Raivata was the Manu: Indra was their king and the celestials were Amitābhas, Abhutarajasas, Vaikunthas, and Sumedhasas each consisting of fourteen divinities. The seven Rishis were Hiranyaromā, Vedasri, Urddhabāhu, Vedabāhu, Sudhāman, Parjānya and Mahāmuni. The sons of Raivata were Balabandhu, Susambhavya, Satyaka and other brave kings.

These four Manus, Swārochishas, Uttami, Tāmasa and Raivata were born in the race of Pryavrata who propitiated Vishnu by his devotions and obtained in consequence thereof these rulers of Manwāntaras as his son.

In the sixth Manwantara Chākshusha was the Manu, when Manojava became the king of the celestials who were grouped as Adyas, Prastutas, Bhavyas, Prithugas, and the high-minded Lekhas each consisting of eight divinities; the seven Rishis were Sumedhas, Virajas, Havishmat, Uttama, Madhu, Abhinaman and Sahishnu. The sons of Chakshusha were the mighty Uru, Puru, Satadyumna and other kings of the earth.

O twice-born one, the Manu, who reigns in the present period is the wise and illustrious lord of obsequies the offspring of the sun. The celestials are the Adityas, Vasus and Rudras. Their king is Purandara. Vasishtha, Kasyapa, Atri, Jamadagni, Gautama, Viswamitra and Bharadwaja are the seven Rishis. And the nine pious sons of Vaivaswata Manu are the kings Ikshawku, Nabhaga, Dhrista, Sanyati, Narishyanta, Nabhanidishta, Karusha, Prishadhra and the well known Vasumat.

The incomparable energy of Vishnu, at one with the quality of goodness and preserving all created things, rules overall the Manwantaras in the shape of divinity. From a part of that divinity Yajna was born in the Swāyambhuva Manwantara the will-begotten child of Akuti. And at the arrival of the Manwantara of Swārochisha the irrepressible Yajna was born as Ajita along with Tushitas the sons of Tushitā. And at the advent of the Manwantara of Auttama, Tushitas were born as the excellent Satyas, of Satya. In the Manwantara of Tāmasa, Satya became Hari along with the Haris, the children of Hari. And in the Raivata Manwantara of Sambhuti the excellent Hari was born as Manasa along with the celestials called Abhutarajasas.

In the next Manwantara Vishnu was born of Vikunthi, as Vaikuntha along with the celestials called Vaikunthas. In the present period Vishnu was again born as Vamana the son of Kasyapa by Aditi. With three paces he conquered the worlds and having released them from all disturbances he gave them to Purandara. By these seven persons, in the various Manwantaras, the created beings have been preserved. He is called Vishnu because his energy pervades the whole world from the root Vis to 'enter' or 'pervade:' and all the celestials, the Manus, the kings of the gods are but the impersonations of the power of Vishnu.
